units.rhetorical_move: a framework is said to measure the value of services in an area intended for projects
units.function: the object is scoped before the method

original_instantiations: the thing being measured is named together with where it applies
the scope comes first

units.source_excerpt: We build a framework to measure the value of the services in an area intended for some projects.
units.reusable_pattern: open by naming what is measured and where
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the object

units.rhetorical_move: a growth is called exponential change limited by a carrying capacity
units.function: a model is glossed in plain words

original_instantiations: the technical model is restated as a fast change held back by a ceiling
the gloss is the definition

units.source_excerpt: We use a growth model to represent the impact, which is exponential change limited by a carrying capacity.
units.reusable_pattern: gloss a model as a limited change
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the model name

units.rhetorical_move: a case is said to agree with the purpose of its kind
units.function: a null result is turned into support

original_instantiations: the absence of an effect is offered as matching the intent
the agreement is the claim

units.source_excerpt: The reserve does not have a significant impact regardless of the area, which agrees with the purpose of such a reserve.
units.reusable_pattern: read a missing effect as agreement with the purpose
reusable_elements: does not have a significant impact
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the place name

units.rhetorical_move: the loss of services is said to leave people worse off
units.function: a citation carries the warning

original_instantiations: the pressure is named and the consequence is a warning backed by a source
the warning is the point

units.source_excerpt: Natural systems are under enormous pressure from human activities. Therefore it is important to remind people that the loss will leave us worse off.
units.reusable_pattern: back a warning with a citation
reusable_elements: therefore it is important to remind
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the citation

units.rhetorical_move: money terms are chosen so the model fits a traditional analysis
units.function: a unit is justified by compatibility

original_instantiations: the unit is picked because the planners already use it
the compatibility is the whole reason

units.source_excerpt: The model measures the services in monetary terms such that it will be efficient for planners to use it in the traditional analysis.
units.reusable_pattern: choose a unit for compatibility with the existing analysis
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the analysis name

units.rhetorical_move: a term is defined as the benefits received freely
units.function: a definition adds one word

original_instantiations: the standard definition is kept and one word is appended
the added word is the point

units.source_excerpt: We define the service as the benefits a person receives from the environment freely.
units.reusable_pattern: extend a definition by one word
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the term

units.rhetorical_move: the value is assumed uniform across the area
units.function: a simplification is stated as an assumption

original_instantiations: the uniformity lets every quantity be a function of area alone
the payoff is the simplification

units.source_excerpt: We assume the value is uniform across the area, therefore all the values are functions of area.
units.reusable_pattern: justify a one-variable model by uniformity
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the variable

units.rhetorical_move: an initial impact is said to lead to an exponentially higher one
units.function: accumulation is narrated

original_instantiations: the system is called interrelated, so a small start grows
the growth is the reason for the equation

units.source_excerpt: Since the system is complicated and interrelated, an initial impact will lead to an exponentially higher consequential impact.
units.reusable_pattern: motivate an equation by accumulation
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the equation

units.rhetorical_move: the environment is said to put a limit on the growth
units.function: a ceiling is given a reason

original_instantiations: the growth is granted and then bounded because it cannot run forever
the bound is the point

units.source_excerpt: However, since the amount cannot be infinitely high or infinitely low, the environment puts a limit on the growth.
units.reusable_pattern: cap a growth by what cannot be infinite
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the variable

units.rhetorical_move: the equation is said to be solved by separation of variables
units.function: the method is named before the algebra

original_instantiations: the technique is announced and the steps follow
the announcement is the guide

units.source_excerpt: We can solve the equation by separation of variables.
units.reusable_pattern: name the technique before the algebra
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the equation

units.rhetorical_move: the sign of the capacity is given three readings
units.function: one parameter sorts the projects

original_instantiations: negative means harm, positive means help, and zero means no change
the three readings are the classification

units.source_excerpt: A negative capacity shows the project is polluting; a positive one indicates it is improving; and zero means it is not affecting the services.
units.reusable_pattern: read one sign three ways
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the parameter name

units.rhetorical_move: the categories are said to be similar to a published assessment
units.function: a classification is borrowed and credited

original_instantiations: the four groups are traced to a named assessment
the credit comes with the list

units.source_excerpt: The categories below are similar to the published assessment, a major effort to analyze the impact of human actions.
units.reusable_pattern: credit a borrowed classification
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the source name

units.rhetorical_move: the supporting services are called the basis for the other three
units.function: one category is ranked above the rest

original_instantiations: the most basic processes are listed and then called the foundation
the ranking is the point

units.source_excerpt: The most fundamental processes allow the earth to sustain basic life forms. These processes are the basis for the other services.
units.reusable_pattern: rank one category as the basis of the others
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the category names

units.rhetorical_move: each combination of variables is said to represent a type
units.function: the typology is announced

original_instantiations: the sign pairs are said to be the types
the announcement precedes the list

units.source_excerpt: Each combination of variables represents a type of project.
units.reusable_pattern: announce a typology before listing it
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the variable names

units.rhetorical_move: a commercial project is said to avoid the cost of cleaning
units.function: a motive is imputed

original_instantiations: the investors are said to skip the treatment if profit is all they want
the imputed motive is the point

units.source_excerpt: If the investors are only interested in making money, they will probably avoid processing the harmful emissions.
units.reusable_pattern: impute a motive to the decision maker
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the industry

units.rhetorical_move: a remedy is said to happen under pressure or altruism
units.function: two motives are offered

original_instantiations: the project is traced to either survival or generosity
both motives are kept

units.source_excerpt: They are usually performed under the pressure of survival or a great altruism.
units.reusable_pattern: give a project two possible motives
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the project type

units.rhetorical_move: a harmful project is said to need close monitoring
units.function: a category is given a warning

original_instantiations: the type is named and the authority is told to watch it
the warning is the point

units.source_excerpt: This type of project should be closely monitored by the local authority, as it will potentially cause serious events.
units.reusable_pattern: attach a warning to a category
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the example

units.rhetorical_move: the numbers are estimated and the equation follows
units.function: an estimate is flagged as one

original_instantiations: the three values are called estimates and then plugged in
the flag is the point

units.source_excerpt: We estimate the coefficient sum, the capacity and the rate. Therefore we have the following equation.
units.reusable_pattern: flag the plugged-in numbers as estimates
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the numbers

units.rhetorical_move: a crossing and a levelling are read off the figure
units.function: two areas are given meanings

original_instantiations: one area makes the value zero and a larger one makes it flat
both readings come from the plot

units.source_excerpt: From the figure we can see that the project turns the value to neutral at one area and brings it to a steady maximum after a larger area.
units.reusable_pattern: read two landmarks off one curve
reusable_elements: from the figure we can see
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the numbers

units.rhetorical_move: a profit is set against a risk of depletion
units.function: the benefit is immediately qualified

original_instantiations: the income is granted and the resource limit is raised against it
the risk is the point

units.source_excerpt: However, at the same time, we have to be aware of the potential risk, since the resources are extremely limited.
units.reusable_pattern: qualify a benefit with the risk beside it
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the crop

units.rhetorical_move: the project is said to lose money before one area and peak at another
units.function: a curve is narrated in three stages

original_instantiations: the loss, the peak and the slow decline are given in order
the order is the story

units.source_excerpt: The project is losing money before the area expands to the first mark, and it reaches the maximum gains at the second.
units.reusable_pattern: narrate a curve as loss, peak and decline
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the numbers

units.rhetorical_move: a stacked chart is said to make the decision clear
units.function: a figure is promoted to a verdict

original_instantiations: the chart is read and the project is said to deserve implementation
the verdict is the point

units.source_excerpt: Based on the chart above, it is clear that this particular project should be implemented.
units.reusable_pattern: turn a chart into a yes
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the project name

units.rhetorical_move: a decrease with area is said to agree with reality
units.function: the curve is matched to a known fact

original_instantiations: the downward curve is offered as matching what is already known
the match is the validation

units.source_excerpt: The total value decreases with increasing area. This agrees with reality.
units.reusable_pattern: match a curve's direction to a known fact
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the place name

units.rhetorical_move: a positive value is called appropriate
units.function: a result is judged by its sign

original_instantiations: the curve staying positive is said to be the right outcome
the sign is the whole judgement

units.source_excerpt: The equation depicts a positive appropriate value of the true cost.
units.reusable_pattern: judge a result by its sign
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the place name

units.rhetorical_move: the model is said to show the threshold of creation and of maximization
units.function: two thresholds are claimed as the payoff

original_instantiations: the curve is said to make both landmarks easy to see
the ease is the claim

units.source_excerpt: This model provides a way to easily view the threshold of value creation and of maximization.
units.reusable_pattern: claim a model makes two thresholds visible
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the threshold names

units.rhetorical_move: the uniformity assumption is admitted to be false
units.function: a limitation is owned

original_instantiations: the assumption the model rests on is said to fail in reality
the admission is direct

units.source_excerpt: This model relies on the assumption that the value across the area is uniform, which is not necessarily true in reality.
units.reusable_pattern: admit the central assumption fails
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the assumption

units.rhetorical_move: the fix is to split the area and sum the pieces
units.function: an improvement is sketched

original_instantiations: the area is divided by land type and each piece gets its own coefficients
the sum is the repaired model

units.source_excerpt: We suggest dividing the area into sections by land type and using different coefficients. Thus the model becomes a summation of many small sections.
units.reusable_pattern: repair a uniform model by splitting it
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the variable names

units.rhetorical_move: the model is said to suit various land types by changing coefficients
units.function: flexibility is located in the coefficients

original_instantiations: the same curve serves every land once the numbers change
the numbers are the flexibility

units.source_excerpt: This model suits various land types with modification of the coefficients.
units.reusable_pattern: locate the flexibility in the coefficients
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the coefficient names

units.rhetorical_move: the true cost is said to become more accurate with the services considered
units.function: accuracy is claimed from completeness

original_instantiations: adding the services is said to make the cost truer
the completeness is the claim

units.source_excerpt: By applying this model, the process of understanding the true costs will be more accurate.
units.reusable_pattern: claim accuracy from counting the services
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the subject wording

units.rhetorical_move: the coefficients are said to be complicated to determine accurately
units.function: the flexibility is priced

original_instantiations: the same coefficients that give flexibility are said to be hard to fix
the difficulty is the limit

units.source_excerpt: However, the determination of these coefficients could be complicated in order to achieve an accurate number.
units.reusable_pattern: price the flexibility at a hard calibration
reusable_elements: could be complicated in order to
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the coefficient names

units.rhetorical_move: the coefficients are said to need careful choice
units.function: a condition is put on the result

original_instantiations: the curve only represents the project if the numbers are chosen well
the condition is the limit

units.source_excerpt: To accurately represent the value, the coefficients have to be chosen carefully to best illustrate the impact.
units.reusable_pattern: condition the result on a careful choice
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the case names

units.rhetorical_move: the model is said to estimate the value effectively
units.function: the close restates the claim

original_instantiations: the case studies are the basis and the effectiveness is the conclusion
the conclusion repeats the opening

units.source_excerpt: From the results of the case studies, we can conclude that this model can effectively estimate the value.
units.reusable_pattern: close by restating the effectiveness
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the case names

units.rhetorical_move: the limitations are said to be revealed despite the strength
units.function: the praise is handed to the caveat

original_instantiations: the strength is granted and the limits follow in the next breath
the turn is the point

units.source_excerpt: Despite the strength shown in the case studies, the model also reveals its limitations.
units.reusable_pattern: turn from the strength to the limits
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the case names

units.rhetorical_move: each source is an author-year line with the title between
units.function: the list mixes journal articles and a report

original_instantiations: an article and a report each take a line
the kinds of source stay apart by entry

units.source_excerpt: Peter Brimblecombe. Attitudes and responses towards air pollution in medieval england. Journal of the Air Pollution Control Association, 1976.
units.reusable_pattern: give each source its own author-year line
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the list as prose
